snippet.title: Fading Echo | PC Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Dive into Fading Echo *today* on Steam and the Epic Games Store!
🌊✨ Your adventure begins here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2467880/Fading_Echo/

Step into Fading Echo, a fast-paced elemental action-adventure RPG. Developed by an independent French studio, you'll unleash spectacular elemental abilities, meet unforgettable characters, and explore the scorched floating isles and shattered dimensions of Corel.

Play as One, a young Legend with a tangled past and precious little time left to save her world. The Paradox Corruption is spreading, reality is collapsing, and Corel is slowly disappearing. Master powerful Ætheric abilities, transform water into a devastating weapon, and slide, shift, and smash your way through breathtaking environments in an epic quest to stop the world's decay.

🎙️ An unforgettable adventure deserves an unforgettable cast!
Samantha Béart stars as One, joined by an incredible lineup featuring Jasmine Bhullar, Laura Bailey, Liam O'Brien, Sam Riegel, and Matt Mercer, who delivers a chilling performance as the game's main antagonist.

🎮 Console releases are planned for later this year.

See you soon in Corel! ✨

💬 *Join the Echoverse on Discord :* https://discord.gg/fadingechogame

🌊 *Follow the Adventure*
YouTube: http://www.youtube.com/@FadingEchoGame?sub_confirmation=1
TikTok: https://www.tiktok.com/@fadingechogame
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/fadingechogame/
Website: https://www.fading-echo.com

Music: Quick - Boudicca

#FadingEcho #Gaming  #indiegames #RPG #Adventure
